summary: Verified iter258 mode-aware Stripe webhook secret. All 5 iter257 unit tests pass (including new _webhook_secret() mode-aware test: test-key→base, live-key→_LIVE, live-key without _LIVE→base fallback). All 4 iter258 preview runtime regressions pass: POST /api/webhook/stripe with bogus/missing signature returns 400 'invalid signature' (NOT 503 — proves base test whsec still active, _LIVE did not hijack); POST /api/payments/checkout for solo AND family returns 200 with cs_test_* session id and checkout.stripe.com url. Iter256 access-state re-run: 12/13 pass — view_only writes → 402, active/trial not blocked, /payments/checkout not blocked for view_only. One unrelated pre-existing failure: GET /api/documents for view_only user returns 409 no_household (fixture user cancelled.vo@example.com has no household — not a regression from this change).

minor.issue: Returns 409 no_household for view_only user cancelled.vo@example.com (fixture has no household). Test iter256::test_view_only_gets_return_200[/api/documents] fails. Pre-existing — unrelated to iter258 webhook change. Either seed a household for the view_only fixture, or drop /api/documents from the GET-200 parametrize list.

action_items: Optional: fix the iter256 access-state fixture so cancelled.vo@example.com has a household (or use a different GET path that doesn't require one) — this is a pre-existing fixture issue, not caused by the webhook mode change.
critical_code_review_comments: _webhook_secret() (routes/payments.py L74–82) correctly gates on _stripe_is_live() and falls back to base STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET when _LIVE is missing — matches the price-id mode-aware pattern.
The webhook handler reads _webhook_secret() at request time (L799), so a mode/env flip needs no restart of the module cache — good.
In preview (sk_test_* key), _stripe_is_live() is False so STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_LIVE is ignored — confirmed by the 400 invalid-signature response (not 503).

success_rate.backend: 95.5% (21/22 executed tests pass; the 1 fail is a pre-existing unrelated fixture issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live-mode _LIVE webhook secret path CANNOT be exercised in preview (sk_test_ key active). It is verified by the monkeypatched unit test test_webhook_secret_is_mode_aware only. On production go-live, once STRIPE_API_KEY flips to sk_live_*, the handler will automatically start using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_LIVE — no code redeploy needed. The pre-existing iter256 /api/documents 409 for view_only is orthogonal and known.
